title: Autonomous Navigation
content:
Our research activities on autonomous navigation focus on:
  • Slam: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping.
  • Path Planning: Optimization algorithms in dynamic environments.
  • Off-road navigation: Autonomous movement in unstructured environments.
  • Machine Learning: Advanced learning algorithms for robotic perception and control.

title: International Robotics Competitions
content:
We actively participate in global challenges to push the limits of autonomous systems, with a strong track record in:
  • MBZIRC 2017: Developed autonomous landing and treasure hunt algorithms.
  • MBZIRC 2020: Implemented advanced multi-robot coordination for autonomous construction and fire-fighting.
  • NXPCUP 2025: Development of autonomous driving and line-following algorithms for high-speed racing on designated tracks.

title: HRI & Smart Walkers
content:
Our research in Human-Robot Interaction focuses on developing intuitive control systems for smart walkers, assisting individuals with reduced mobility. We study:
  • Intention Recognition via force sensors.
  • Shared Control Navigation.
  • Prototype development: Design and realization of smart walker platforms.

title: Beach Cleaning & Mobile Manipulation
content:
Development of autonomous systems for environmental preservation, specifically focusing on:
  • Mobile Manipulation: Coordination between robotic bases and arms for litter collection.
  • Object detection in sandy terrains.
  • Autonomous coverage for beach maintenance.

title: Aerial Environmental Monitoring
content:
Research on UAV platforms for safety and environmental inspection in hazardous areas:
  • Environmental monitoring in dangerous or inaccessible locations.
  • Sensor fusion for real-time gas or radiation detection.
  • Multi-robot coordination for large-scale surveillance.
